exposure: placement of cervical ripening balloon catheter for >12h
double balloon combined with oxytocin for labor induction
cohort: 230 pregnant women who underwent cervical ripening double balloon combined with oxytocin for labor induction at a single hospital from September 2021 to August 2022.
finding: Acute chorioamnionitis, fetal distress, and placement of cervical ripening balloon catheter for >12h were associated with a lower success rate of cervical ripening double balloon combined with oxytocin for labor induction, while multi-gravidity was associated with a higher success rate.
